\begin{document}
The bare propagator of the level is
\begin{equation}
G^0(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega - \epsilon_0} .
\label{eq:g0}
\end{equation}
Its residue at the pole is one,
\begin{equation}
(\omega-\epsilon_0)\, G^0(\omega) = 1 .
\label{eq:res}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
